chunks: Yet there are some who contend about God without any knowledge or guidance or enlightening Book,
ai.seo_question: What are the three deficiencies of those who argue about God without true understanding?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Hajj is often interpreted as a critique of those who engage in theological debate without the triad of 'ilm (knowledge), hudan (guidance), and kitaban muniran (an illuminating Book), which some scholars link to the Ahl al-Bayt or the Quran itself. It underscores the necessity of divine illumination and authentic tradition in establishing valid theological discourse, distinguishing true believers from those who argue merely on opinion or ignorance.
